relationships.evidence_summary: NSW Planning identifies the Greater Parramatta to Olympic Peninsula corridor as part of Greater Sydney's Central City.
relationships.scope_note: This permits only the two named locality labels with matching postcode 2150 and an external point in the stated small Parramatta CBD review window. The window is a deliberately restrictive validation condition, not an official suburb boundary. It does not assert that the City of Sydney LGA contains Parramatta. No other city/suburb relationship is inferred.
